_comment: TTTR <-> .pto converter, native emtk window. Drawn by emtk.view_form over TttrToPtoModel (gui/model.py); Help and Guide, the file dialog and the drop are drawn or handled by gui/app.py.
title: TTTR <-> .pto

sections.text: Drop vendor photon file(s) (.ptu, .spc, .ht3, ...) to pack them into one .pto beside the first, or drop a .pto to unpack the original vendor file(s) back out. Whichever direction you drop, the file(s) you dropped are kept untouched.
sections.description: What the tool does: the drop decides the direction, and nothing you drop is changed or deleted.
Add files with a dialog instead of dropping them, or forget the finished entries.

buttons.label: Add files...
buttons.description: Choose vendor photon files to pack into one .pto, or .pto containers to unpack. Same as dropping them on the window.

buttons.label: Clear history
buttons.description: Remove the finished entries from the list; the files on disk stay untouched.

sections.description: How many conversions were asked for and how they ended.

One row per conversion, newest last. A vendor file is packed into a .pto beside it (files dropped together become one container, in file-name order); a .pto is unpacked to the vendor files and results it holds. Hover a row for the full paths.

columns.title: Status
columns.tooltip: Queued, Converting, Verified (the written file passed its checksum), Failed, Rejected or Not completed.

columns.title: Action
columns.tooltip: Pack: vendor file(s) into a .pto. Unpack: a .pto back to its vendor file(s) and results.

columns.title: Files
columns.tooltip: The file(s) you dropped, in the order they are packed.

columns.title: Result
columns.tooltip: The file(s) written, or why the conversion failed or the file was rejected.
